subject: Request: temporary alternate purchase path for Talon Platform pilot
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@talonplatform.com>

Cc: procurement@talonplatform.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:22 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing flexibility request (Talon & Redwood)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to try the Redwood Dedicated pilot for our real-time ingestion use case. One quick operational ask from our side: our legal and procurement teams require a signed vendor form before we can issue a PO. That process takes ~2–3 weeks and would delay the pilot start.

Would Redwood consider a temporary "invoice-first" intake for the pilot (Net 30) with the understanding that a formal PO and supplier profile will be completed before expansion? We can sign a short-term invoice agreement and provide a scanned W-9 and POC contact immediately.

I've attached a short SOW and a one-page summary of our procurement constraints for context.

Attachment: TP-SOW.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Talon-terms-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Integrations
Talon Platform
elllen@talonplatform.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing flexibility request (Talon & Redwood)

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and for the SOW. Appreciate the heads up on your procurement timeline.

Quick read: the pilot looks low risk from a data/compliance standpoint and is limited to a single project account, so I think there's room to be pragmatic. Looping in Priya (procurement) and Ben (finance) to confirm operational steps and the exact paperwork we need to accept invoices short-term.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- Talon sends W-9 + signed SOW (you already included SOW — thank you).
- Sign our Temporary Invoice Agreement (template attached by procurement).
- Redwood will provision pilot access under a trial billing code and accept invoices Net 30.
- Procurement follow-up to confirm when the formal supplier profile and PO will be completed (expected window: 14–21 days).

If procurement needs additional risk evidence (certs, SOC attestation), let us know and we can surface it.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
slee@redwood.com

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:42:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing flexibility request (Talon & Redwood)

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed the attachments. Procurement is okay with a temporary invoice path for a pilot under the following conditions: 

Checklist for approval:
- Signed Temporary Invoice Agreement on Redwood template (procurement will prepare).
- W-9 or equivalent vendor tax docs received and verified.
- Point of Contact (POC) & billing email defined (we need invoices to route to invoices@redwood.com).
- Maximum pilot commitment capped at $12,000 in invoiced spend unless an explicit finance uplift is approved.
- Finance (Ben) to approve Net 30 terms for this vendor on a case-by-case basis.
- Procurement to open a supplier onboarding ticket and track completion of the formal supplier profile and PO within 21 calendar days.

I've attached the Temporary-invoice-agreement.docx draft. Please ask Talon to sign and return. Once Ben signs off on the Net 30 cap, I will mark this as an approved exception and create the supplier ticket.

Attachment: Temporary-invoice-agreement.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@talonplatform.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot billing flexibility request (Talon & Redwood)

All good from finance — we can approve Net 30 for this pilot and set the spend cap to $12,000. A couple operational notes:

- Please ensure invoices include the trial billing code: TRIAL-TP-43892 and are sent to invoices@redwood.com.
- Finance will not process payment until the Temporary Invoice Agreement is signed and W-9 received, but we'll queue the payment on receipt.
- If Talon needs advance confirmation for internal reasons, we can issue a one-page "authorization to invoice" letter after procurement receives the signed agreement.

Ellen — if you can return the signed doc and W-9 today/tomorrow we'll aim to have the supplier ticket created and provisioning complete by EOD Monday.
